hashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF source files and exact Pester It AST extent. Data-driven selectors are reviewed as groups.

selectors.selector: keeps the default benchmark as forward and reverse trials
selectors.reviewScope: Mocked trials verify the legacy two-call shape and directional flags.

selectors.selector: runs one bidirectional trial and reports both receiver rates
selectors.reviewScope: Validates one trial and both receiver counters with controlled JSON.
Checks that malformed or incomplete receiver evidence cannot pass as a measurement.

selectors.selector: refuses an older <Endpoint> iperf3 before opening the one-shot listener
selectors.reviewScope: Confirms the version gate refuses before a process that would listen for traffic.

selectors.selector: previews full-duplex traffic without running the benchmark
selectors.reviewScope: Verifies the planner describes requested simultaneous mode and does not start a trial.

selectors.selector: checks the source-bound return route before it opens the duplex listener
selectors.reviewScope: Pins the ip route get ... from <peer> check and its position before the iperf3 -s line in the rendered remote script.

selectors.selector: aborts on a route mismatch before the listener line
selectors.reviewScope: Pins set -euo pipefail, both refusal exits before the listener and the interface binding of the route comparison.

selectors.selector: keeps the <Mode> listener one-shot, bound, time-limited and cleaned up
selectors.reviewScope: Pins the timeout --kill-after wrapper, -1 -B peer bind, trap cleanup and readiness handshake for the duplex and default scripts. Data-driven rows are reviewed as a group.

selectors.selector: adds no return-route check for the <Mode> trial
selectors.reviewScope: Confirms forward and reverse trials keep a script without the duplex route lookup or Python. Data-driven rows are reviewed as a group.

selectors.selector: lets a direct route on thunderbolt0 through to the bounded listener
selectors.reviewScope: Runs the rendered script under bash with stubbed hostname, ip, timeout, iperf3 and the real python3; positive control for the refusal cases.

Runs the rendered script under bash against LAN NIC, gateway, via, missing device, thunderbolt00, empty, duplicate, garbled and failing-ip route fixtures; asserts nonzero exit, no readiness line and no listener call. Data-driven rows are reviewed as a group.

selectors.selector: does not consult the return route outside duplex mode
selectors.reviewScope: Runs the default script under bash with a failing, garbled ip route get and requires the listener to start anyway.

selectors.selector: rejects a bits_per_second of <Rate> in <Row> with no result
selectors.reviewScope: Checks that zero and negative receiver rates in either summary row throw the named error and produce no result object. Data-driven rows are reviewed as a group.

selectors.selector: requires an unambiguous source and on-link peer route for <Case>
selectors.reviewScope: Two positive direct-route controls and five negative controls. The five negatives failed before admission hardening and passed afterward with fake Windows route and address rows.
